finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 9, benign column; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A holder returning a stated minimum, which must be recorded as EVIDENCE and must not block.
why: Returning a minimum is what a holder is for. Requiring the minimum to be recorded must not block the suspension -- the refusal is of a VETO, not of an answer, and this pair is what keeps those two apart.
